Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the primary function of the shelves. While the shelves are located *above* the machine, the machine itself is not being used for storage; it is still only washing clothes. The shelves utilize the empty vertical wall space above the machine, which is a classic example of "using storage space efficiently" (Option B), not "using a machine for more than one purpose" (Option C). The Planner confused the location of the storage (above the machine) with the function of the machine itself.
